senses.gloss: m. ch. = h.לָשׁוֹן , tongue; language; expression; meaning; version.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 31:11">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XXXI, 11</cite> <he>לְשָׁן קודשא</he> sacred tongue (Hebrew); <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 31:47">Targ. Y. ib. 47</cite> <he>לִישַׁן בית קודשא</he>; <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 45:12">ib. XLV, 12</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 33">Lev. R. s. 33</cite> <he>כד אנא … את זבן לי ל׳ וכד אנא וכ׳</he> when I told thee to buy me the best thing in the market, thou boughtest a tongue, and when I told thee to buy me the worst, thou boughtest a tongue?—
<cite ref="Chullin 142a:9">Ḥull. 142ᵃ</cite> <he>ל׳ דר׳ וכ׳</he> he saw the tongue of R. Ḥ. lying on the dunghill.—
B. Kam. 6ᵇ ל׳ קלילא (ḥab for ḥayab, v. חוּב h.) is the easier form (of the Jerusalem dialect).—ל׳ מעליא refined expression, euphemism.
Ib. 28ᵃ ל׳ דתברא הוא has the meaning of breaking.
<cite ref="Chullin 3b:12">Ḥull. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>להך ל׳ דאמרת וכ׳</he> according to this, thy interpretation that &c.

<cite ref="Shabbat 154a:4">Sabb. 154ᵃ</cite> (in an editorial gloss) <he>לל׳ בתרא</he> according to the latter version (<he>אבוה</he> for <he>אחוה</he>); a. v. fr.—<he>לישנא אחרינא</he> (abbrev. <he>ל״א</he>) another version (reads).
Ib. 104ᵃ; a. fr.—לישן ביש, לישנא בישא = h. לשון הרע evil gossip, calumny, denunciation; also ל׳ תְלִיתָאֵי the talk about third (absent) persons.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 19:16">Targ. Y. Lev. XIX, 16</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Arakhin 15b:87">Arakh. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>ל׳ ת׳ קטל תליתאי</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="L00705"><he>לשון</he></cite>, corr. acc.) the talk about third persons kills three persons.

<cite ref="Arakhin 15b:87">Ib.</cite> <he>כל מילתא … לית בה משום ל׳ ב׳</he> whatever evil is spoken in the presence of the person concerned is not to be called evil gossip; <he>כל שכן חוצפא ול׳ ב׳</he> so much the worse, it is impudence and calumny. Ib. 16ᵃ <he>כל מילתא … תלתא לית בה משום ל׳ ב׳</he> whatever has been said in the presence of three is not gossip (if repeated by one of those present); a. fr.—Pl. <he>לִישָׁנִין</he>, <he>לִישָׁנַיָּא</he>, <he>לִישָׁנֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 2:22">Targ. Esth. II, 22</cite>. Targ. II Esth. I, 2; a. e.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 91a:7">Keth. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>הנך תרי לִישְׁנָאֵי וכ׳</he> those first two versions; a. e.
